Main Module

Data Change Detection System

This system helps data scientists and analysts maintain data integrity by: 1. Automatically detecting when data files change 2. Providing clear, human-readable change reports 3. Maintaining a history of all data modifications 4. Generating comprehensive documentation

Key Features: - Transparent monitoring of data read operations - Detailed change detection and reporting - Historical state tracking - Automatic documentation generation

Example Usage:

```python import pandas as pd

# Regular pandas read_csv is automatically monitored df = pd.read_csv(‘my_data.csv’)

# If the file changes and is read again, you’ll get a report: df = pd.read_csv(‘my_data.csv’) # Will show changes if any ```

main.monitor_csv_reading(filepath, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Enhanced version of pandas.read_csv that tracks data changes.

This function: 1. Reads the CSV file normally 2. Creates a summary of its contents 3. Checks if the data changed since last read 4. Reports any changes found 5. Updates the change history

The main module provides the core functionality of the GTO Data Change Detection system. It includes:

  • Data change monitoring

  • Documentation generation

  • System demonstration

Example Usage

from main import demonstrate_functionality

# Run the demonstration
demonstrate_functionality()

# Generate documentation
generate_documentation()
